'''Michael Fortman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Washington State Championship]] on 21 April 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS]], according to Charles Hickey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2128">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-washington-states-the-hickey-chroniclesd2128/ washington-states-the-hickey-chronicles], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 22 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-washington-states-the-hickey-chroniclesd2128/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
